question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Which character from Dinah's story did you like the most?
Have you ever written a story?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Look, there are a lot of issues you have to work out with this story...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: But exploring your villain's motivation is a good place to start.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: What you need to do is think long and hard about this Katrina. Figure out what makes this evil vampire tick.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And when you truly understand her... You'll be able to finish your story.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: O... Okay.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I guess that's it for today's meeting.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: See you all next time.
The rest of the lit club leaves, but Dinah and Mallika linger in the library.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Andrew hated it!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: It's not that bad... Like he said, you just need to do some revisions.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Heh... You should have seen the first short story that I brought in to be workshopped... Andrew really ripped it apart.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I mean, literally... He tore it up and threw it on the ground...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: But that was just my first draft! After that, I improved it!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: By the end, it was so good that Andrew ran it in the lit club's magazine.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: So... I guess that means there's some hope for my story?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Exactly! You just need an amazing ending! And, as much as I hate to say it, you should spend some time thinking about your villain.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Okay... I can do that...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: That's the right attitude! I'd better get to class, but good luck with your revising. See you later!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Okay... As much as I hate to admit it, I `might` have based the villain in the story off of Kat...
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay... As much as I hate to admit it, I [color=#3b78e2][i]might[/i][/color] have based the villain in the story off of Kat...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: So... To make this a better story... I guess I've got to try to understand Kat.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: We have some classes together...
The next day in English class, Dinah sits next to Kat as Mrs. Faulkner hands back last week's tests.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Faulkner
nodes.text: Kat, I'm afraid I'll need to see you after class to discuss your grade.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Y... Yes, Mrs. Faulkner.
Mrs. Faulkner goes to the board and begins lecturing as she writes.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Here's my chance to talk to Kat...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Psst! Hey, Kat.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Dinah? What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Gulp.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh... Tough test, huh?

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Uh... I thought it was easy! I... Uh... Totally aced it!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Kat's acting funny... I wonder if she's lying about her test!
Dinah looks over at Kat's test.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hmm... I can almost see her grade...
Dinah leans over to get a peek at the grade on Kat's test...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Well, that certainly comes across in your writing.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: But then the question becomes `why` is she evil? What causes her to be this way?
nodes.text_bbcode: But then the question becomes [color=#e23b3b][i]why[/i][/color] is she evil? What causes her to be this way?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Evil characters can be very fascinating... But not if there's no explanation about what drives them.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Just think about the possibilities... A troubled childhood? Past persecution? Struggles with poverty?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Heh... Maybe she grew up next to an Italian restaurant, and all the garlic gave her allergies!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Um... Let's put that in the 'maybe' pile...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: But I think you get the general idea.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Really? Are you sure? Because I think you're lying!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I pride myself in my ability to read subtext...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And I've seen text messages with more subtext than your story!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Look, Dinah, if you're going to be a part of the lit club, you're going to need to do some major revisions to this piece.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: But I don't think it's hopeless.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Hey! I liked the characters! Give Dinah a break... This is her first story that she's shared with the group.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Sorry, Mallika, but the point of this group isn't to sit around congratulating each other... We're trying to give Dinah real feedback.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: So... Um... What do you think I should do to change it?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: For one thing, you need to work on your descriptions.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: But more importantly, you really need to give your characters depth.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Take this evil Katrina for example. Why is she evil? What made her that way?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: What were you thinking when you wrote this character? Is she really evil? Or just misunderstood?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: She's...

nodes.prompt: Is she really evil? Or just misunderstood?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Is she really evil? Or just misunderstood?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I'll start. I hate to say it, but the entire story felt a little flat.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Something about it just didn't feel right. The whole thing was just awkward and confusing.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I'm inclined to agree with Ashley.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Whew, it's getting late... Well, that's five pages. I guess that's a good place to stop. I really hope the lit club kids like the story so far...
Dinah emails the story to the Lit club...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Now I just have to wait...
The next day after school, Dinah shows up at the lit club meeting with Mallika...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: So, we've all taken some time to read through what Dinah has so far on this piece... Let's go around and say what we thought of it.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Gulp!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I'm so nervous... What if they didn't like it?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Dinahella pushed Brendward aside and tackled Katrina!'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'It was a vicious battle!'

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: Have at thee!

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: Hiss!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'But suddenly, Brendward stepped between them, pushing them apart!'

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: Stop! Stop this fighting!

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: Dinahella, I can't let you get hurt for my sake. I must go with her.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Just as the evil vampire drew near...'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Dinahella leaned closer to Brendward...'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'And kissed him!'

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: I will always love you.

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: But now I must go... For your sake.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: Heh heh heh!

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: You surprise me, Brendward. Don't you have any concern for the girl's safety? I would hate to think she might get `hurt` if you refuse to come with me...
nodes.text_bbcode: You surprise me, Brendward. Don't you have any concern for the girl's safety? I would hate to think she might get [color=#3b78e2][i]hurt[/i][/color] if you refuse to come with me...

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: You... You wouldn't!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Katrina darted forward and grabbed Brendward's hand!'

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: Now then, let's go.

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: Oh no! What should I do?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hmm... What `should` Dinahella do?

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: I can't allow him to be happy with you! I'd rather he be miserable than be with you!

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: What chance do I have against this beautiful, powerful vampire? I guess I might as well give up...

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: Don't give up! There must be a way we can be together...

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: Brendward deserves to be ruling the vampire world!

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: He shouldn't be wasting his time with a silly, little human girl.

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: I... I would never want to stand in his way.

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: Don't say that Dinahella! I don't want to be the King of the Vampires! I just want to be with you!

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: Oh, Brendward...

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: You may call me Brendward!

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: I should warn you... I have a dark and terrible secret...

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: Oh?

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: Unfortunately, I am... A vampire!

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: A vampire?!

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: But I'm a good vampire! I promise, Dinahella, I'll never do anything to hurt you!

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: Oh, Brendward... That's so sweet... I don't care if you're a vampire! I'm not afraid!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'And from that moment on, they were inseparable.'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'The days passed quickly and pleasantly as they filled their time with moonlit picnics, strolls through the woods, and gazing lovingly into each other's eyes.'

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: Fairest...

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: Dearest...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Yes, never did two fall in love like Dinahella and Brendward.'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'But alas, true love is never so simple.'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'An evil, beautiful vampire was determined to ruin Dinahella's happiness.'

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: Heh heh heh! I am Katrina, Queen of the Vampires!

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: Your happiness is at an end! Brendward must come with me!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Katrina was determined to steal Brendward away and... Um...'

nodes.prompt: Katrina was determined to steal Brendward away and...

options.label: Make him King of the Vampires!

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Katrina was determined to steal Brendward away and...

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: You must be new to the village.

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: In a village as small as ours, even a new carthorse causes a stir.

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: Not that you're like a carthorse! You're much prettier than a carthorse!

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: Hee hee... Thank you, kind sir. My name is Dinahella.

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: You're so handsome!

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: Why, thank you. I certainly am dashing.

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: If you want, you may gaze longingly at my countenance.

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: Um... Maybe we can do that later.

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: Indeed. And what shall I call thee, maiden?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'His smile devastated her, but she clumsily tried to remember her name...'

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: I'm... Uh... Dinahella.

nodes.title: Writer's Block
nodes.subtitle: Can you help Dinah tell her story?

nodes.text: It's Monday night, and Dinah is hard at work finishing up a story.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I can't believe Mallika talked me into sharing a story at the bi-weekly lit club meeting...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: She said I need to bring in the first five pages... That shouldn't be too hard to write... I just have to get through the beginning!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Okay... I need to write something fun... Something interesting...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hey, everyone loves that 'Dusklight' novel... And I do like vampires. Maybe I should write something like that! I'll call it 'Sunset'...
Dinah takes a deep breath and begins typing...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Long ago in a simpler time, Dinahella Nightingale was out gathering flowers...'

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: Oh, if only I had someone to love.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'But as she knelt to pick a wild rose that was growing in the clearing, she suddenly heard a noise!'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'She looked up, and she saw `him!` The boy who would change her life!'
nodes.text_bbcode: 'She looked up, and she saw [color=#3b78e2][i]him![/i][/color] The boy who would change her life!'

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: Oh my! Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: Yes. I'm terribly sorry for disturbing you!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Dinahella didn't know it then, but she was just seconds away from falling in love!'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hmm... Why should Dinahella love Brendward? Oh, I know!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Dinahella immediately fell for Brendward because he was so...'

nodes.prompt: Dinahella immediately fell for Brendward because he was so...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Dinahella immediately fell for Brendward because he was so...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Umm... So, how about that one sci-fi show with the robots... Er... And space ships?

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: You mean 'Brittlestar Galacticus'? You watch 'Brittlestar Galacticus'?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh... Sure. See, just because I'm goth doesn't mean I'm scary.

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Heh. Right! Like Admiral Adoba is always saying, 'We're not so different from the machines'...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I'm not a robot... Er...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I mean, yeah. Exactly. So, could I ask you a few questions?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I'm really curious... What happened with Kat? I thought she used to be part of the nerd group.

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Oh, Kat? She was one of us...

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Until she dumped Spud! And now she's even started dating Brendan! Can you believe that girl?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: What does Brendan have to do with anything?

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Are you serious? Spud's our leader! We can't still be friends with Kat after she broke his heart!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: As long as Kat's with Brendan, she's not one of us anymore.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Poor Kat... I guess she gave up her friends so she could date Brendan...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: But there's something a little weird going on here... Why was Kat looking over at Spud during lunch if she's the one that broke his heart?

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: So... Want to go watch some 'Brittlestar Galacticus' webisodes?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Huh? Oh, maybe some other time...
Kat turns and leaves.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well... Who knows whether or not Kat will really tell Brendan...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Either way, I guess I'd better get to work on my story.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: That's low, Dinah.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I know you won't believe me, but I'm not doing this to get back at you...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: It's just that Brendan is my friend... And he's a good guy. He deserves to know the truth.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: But I think he'd appreciate hearing it from you, so I want to give you the chance to tell him.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: That's... Sort of decent of you, Dinah. I'm not sure if I can go through with telling Brendan, but I... I guess I have to try.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Just think about it... Right now, you're already feeling guilty.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Imagine how much worse it's going to be ten years from now... You've got three kids and a mortgage...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: And the only thing keeping you from being totally happy is this huge secret...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Fast forward five years later: car accident. He dies in your arms, never knowing the truth.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Okay, okay! I'll think about it! Just back off, crazy!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Kat didn't sound very convinced...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: But I really think you need to tell Brendan the truth.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: I can't. I just can't!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Kat...

options.label: If you don't tell him, I will.
You can't build a relationship on a lie.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Dinah... I know we have our differences, but you can't tell Brendan about me and Spud!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You and Spud?

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: It was a mistake! I never should have kissed him!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yikes! So that's why Kat's been acting so weird!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Look, I'm not asking you to do this for me... Think about Brendan! If you tell him, it will devastate him!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: But... What about you and Spud?

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Things are over between me and Spud. It was a moment of weakness! It was temporary insanity!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Please, Dinah... Don't tell him...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Look, Kat... I understand that this is hard for you...

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Sure... Like I'll believe that!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: I can tell you know... It's written all over your guilty, gothy face!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: What? I really don't know what you're talking about. Why don't we just both forget that this ever happened...

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Sure... Like you'd find out that I kissed Spud and not even tell Brendan.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You kissed Spud?!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Riiight. You're a pretty good liar, you know that? `But not good enough.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Riiight. You're a pretty good liar, you know that? [color=#3b78e2][i]But not good enough.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: What was your plan? Tell Brendan that I cheated on him? Get him to break up with me?

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Then you can be his shoulder to cry on about how his stupid ex-girlfriend broke his heart? Is that what you wanted, Dinah?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Look, Kat, I didn't have any kind of 'plan' to split you and Brendan up...

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Hey!
Dinah quickly logs out of Kat's email.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Kat! Um... Sorry, were you using this computer?

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Don't play dumb! I saw you reading my email!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: But... It was... Just to understand you...

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: I don't know what you're talking about, but you had no right to look through my emails!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Girls! No shouting in the library!
Kat lowers her voice to a whisper and steps closer to Dinah...

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: What did you read in my email?
Dinah clicks on the email...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Dear Brendan...'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Where are you? Why aren't you answering my calls?'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Are you cheating on me or something?'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Call me back `or else!` Love, Kat.'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well, Kat's paranoid and crazy. I guess that email didn't exactly tell me anything new...
Dinah clicks on the email...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Spud...'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'I can't forget what happened before that 'Ogres and Elves' tournament! I felt so lost and confused...'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'What if Brendan finds out the truth?! I hate lying to him, but I can't tell him the truth!'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'What are we going to do?!'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: What happened between Kat and Spud?!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Tell me the truth, Dexter! What's going on with Kat?!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: You're scary! I don't want to talk to you!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: No, wait....

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Shoot... I guess I could have been a little nicer to Dexter...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Looks like I'll have to figure out another way to get to learn more about Kat.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: I called you twice, Brendan! Why didn't you answer me?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: My hands were full! My phone was on silent! I wasn't getting reception! There was a long line to buy lunch!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: That's one excuse too many! You're lying! Why are you avoiding my calls?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Kat! I was on my way here, and I didn't get to my phone in time... Is that really such a crime?

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: You weren't making out with another girl, were you?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Of course not... Can we please just have lunch now?

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Yeah... Yeah, sorry. Let's just eat.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I wonder why Kat's so paranoid about Brendan cheating on her...
As Dinah watches, Kat glances across the room, to a table where Spud is sitting... Then quickly looks back at her food.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Whoa, what was that look? Hey, why doesn't Kat hang out with the nerd group anymore?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I definitely remember seeing her with Dexter, Ashley, and Spud.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Now it's like she never even talks to them...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I guess there's a lot about Kat I don't really understand.
After lunch, Dinah sees Dexter walking through the hallway.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hey! Dexter!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Eek! You're that creepy goth girl... What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Dexter, I was wondering if I could ask you a few questions.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Calm down... I'm not going to hurt you....

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Okay... I've got to get to the bottom of this without scaring him off...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: There's Kat... I wonder why she's eating by herself...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: She looks pretty upset...
Dinah takes a seat at a nearby table to watch Kat.
As Dinah watches, Kat takes out her cell phone and tries calling Brendan.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I guess she's just waiting for him...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Maybe she doesn't have anyone else to talk to... Now that I think about it, I haven't really seen her hanging out with anyone else lately...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Maybe that's why she's so clingy all the time...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wow... I never thought I'd actually feel bad for Kat... But it must be really lonely to not have any other friends.
As Dinah watches, Brendan shows up.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey, Kat. Sorry I'm late...
Dinah goes over to the lockers in the hallway.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Rats... It looks like Kat isn't here.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dinah? Hey.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hi, Brendan.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm sorry about earlier... I really don't know what's gotten into Kat.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yeah... I hope I didn't get you in trouble.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No! No, it's not your fault at all! She's just very... Protective of me.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Speaking of which, I'm already late for lunch with her. I'd better get over to the cafeteria!
Brendan runs off towards the cafeteria...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Why is Kat always so clingy? It's like she never lets Brendan do what he wants to...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I can't believe she's so controlling and possessive!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wait a second... I'm supposed to be understanding Kat, not getting mad at her! I guess I need to try harder.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: At least I know where she is now...
Dinah follows Brendan to the cafeteria and takes a seat at a nearby table so she can overhear what he and Kat are talking about...
After a torturous session of gym class, it's time for lunch.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I thought gym class would never end... I'd better hurry if I'm going to catch Kat.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Let's see... Should I try to find her at her locker or just go straight to the cafeteria?

nodes.prompt: Should I try to find her at her locker or just go straight to the cafeteria?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Should I try to find her at her locker or just go straight to the cafeteria?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Our resilient heroine, Dinahella Nightingale, raised one delicate, trembling hand and brushed her long, lustrous, obsidian tresses away from her soft, somber face.'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'She felt a chilling rush of fear sweep through her, rooting her to the very spot upon which she stood.'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'She stared at the terrifying vampire, Katrina, whose fearsome beauty was matched only by her ruthless cunning. The vampire's eyes seemed to cut deep into her very mind!'

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: Hiss...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'But she drew courage from her true love, the dashing Brendward. She looked at his tousled hair, his charming smile, and his broad shoulders.'

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: Be strong, Dinahella!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Storm clouds began to gather threateningly in the distance... And Dinahella knew it was now or never!'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wow, that's a great description! I bet the lit club is going to love the new story!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ha ha ha! That's a good one, Dinah.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Kat's totally in love with me! And I'm totally in love with her!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But you really shouldn't joke about that. Man, I can't even imagine how horribly devastated I'd be if Kat really did cheat on me.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, it's a good thing I'll never have to deal with that. Ever.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Anyway, like I was saying... I've got to look out for my relationship with Kat... Even if that means we can't really be friends anymore.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Kat would do the same for me! And I really want to make things work with her...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I... I guess I understand.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You might be right, Dinah. Man, it's a relief to finally admit that.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Kat and I have been together for so long, I can't imagine being with anyone else...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Um... You've only been dating for a few months...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Three months exactly!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ooh, which reminds me, it's our monthary today!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Err... What?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Our monthly anniversary. Kat calls them montharies.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And I almost forgot about it! Yikes! I'd better go get some flowers and chocolates, or Kat's going to kill me...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yeah... I guess I better get to class anyway...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'It was another day in some place or another...'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Maybe at the beach?'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Um... And we're at the beach because... The dashing Brendward is also a pirate!'

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: Arrr?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Yup, a vampire pirate! That's cool, right?'

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: Aye, that thar don't make a bit o' sense, lassie.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: And what are we doing out in the middle of the day?! Vampires can't be out in sunlight!

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: Aye!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: That dashing pirate is right... This doesn't make any sense. I'm never going to get this story finished!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wait... No! It's okay. I just need to think this through.
That night, Dinah sits down at her computer to rewrite her story...
Okay, this is it! The pressure is really on...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: But I think I understand more about Kat, and that was the main thing. What else did Andrew say?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh, right. I needed more descriptions... So I guess I should start with that before I even get into the character of Katrina.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Dinahella Nightingale is...'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Shoot... How should I describe her?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Dinah, this is worse than it was before!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: What? But I worked so hard on it!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: This gives short stories everywhere a bad name!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Just look at this scene...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Dinahella loved Brendward dearly, but the hideous, evil Katrina kept him captive in a web of lies!'

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: Brendward will never be yours, Dinahella!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: What's wrong with that?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: At least in your first draft, Katrina was beautiful. Now she's hideous?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And that's not even the worst part...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Little did Brendward know that Katrina was in love with another man... The sinister werewolf, Smud!'

nodes.speaker: Smud
nodes.text: But what if Brendward were to find out about our love?

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: Oh, you needn't worry about Brendward! He's hopelessly in love with me!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: So? What's wrong with that?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You didn't listen to any of my advice! If anything, you've got even less of an understanding of your villain than when you started!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I didn't think it was bad... In fact, I think this story is pretty juicy gossip! If I'm not mistaken, this 'Evil Smud' bears some resemblance to `Spud!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I didn't think it was bad... In fact, I think this story is pretty juicy gossip! If I'm not mistaken, this 'Evil Smud' bears some resemblance to [color=#3b78e2][i]Spud![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Dinah, I'm afraid I'm going to have to permanently remove you from the literature club.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And for everyone's sake, Dinah, please don't go near a short story ever again!
The next day at lunch...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dinah! I've been looking for you!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Brendan? What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Is it true that you wrote this?!
Brendan holds up a copy of Dinah's short story.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh... Yeah... That's my story. How did you get that?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ashley made copies and gave them out to all of the nerds during science class! So I read the whole thing, and I'm pretty sure I see what's going on here...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: It's... It's not what you think!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I think you found out that Kat cheated on me! And then you wrote a thinly-veiled story about it!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh... Uh... That story could mean anything!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: The whole school is saying that it means Kat cheated on me! How could you do this to me, Dinah?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's bad enough that Kat kissed some other guy... But now thanks to your stupid story, the whole school knows!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I'm so sorry, Brendan! I didn't think about that when I wrote it...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I can't believe you, Dinah... I can't believe you'd do something like this to me.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Brendan, please...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I don't want to hear it, Dinah. Just leave me alone.
Dinah betrayed Brendan's trust, got kicked out of the literature club, and is left friendless and alone, all thanks to you.
You should feel horrible.
But luckily, you've got a chance to set things right! Give it another try and you just might get a better ending!

args.text: Try again! You can do it!

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Dinah? What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I've been doing a lot of thinking, Kat... You're not right for Brendan, and I'm not going to let this go on any longer!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I want you to break up with Brendan.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: But... But yesterday you said...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I know what I said, but I changed my mind! I don't just want you to be honest, I want you out of Brendan's life!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: So here's what you're going to do... You're going to break up with Brendan! And you're never going to talk to him again!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Or else I'll tell him everything!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: You... You wouldn't!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I would!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: But... What if I tell him first?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Then I'll just make up something else! He'll already know that he can't trust you!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hmm, let's see... Who should I say that you made out with? Zach? Dexter? Hector? Maybe all three!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: But... But... That's a lie!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Right... You should know all about lies. You've been lying to Brendan for the past month!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Think of it this way... I'm offering you the chance to break up with Brendan without him ever needing to know the horrible truth.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Fine... Have it your way... I'll break up with Brendan.
After a very long day of classes, it's finally time for the lit club meeting.
Dinah hands out copies of her story and nervously waits as everyone reads...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Dinah, this story is a true work of art!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You like it?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I love it! This twist... It's amazing!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Just look at this ending...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'And so, it seemed that all was lost!'

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: You'll never steal Brendward from me! No mere human could possibly rival my beauty!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'But then, Dinahella revealed a shocking twist!'

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: Perhaps no mere human could rival your beauty... But luckily `I` am `also` a vampire!
nodes.text_bbcode: Perhaps no mere human could rival your beauty... But luckily [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] am [color=#3b78e2][i]also[/i][/color] a vampire!

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: Yes! Now we will battle!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'And after the vicious fight was over, only Dinahella stood victorious.'

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: Er... Well done... But did you really have to banish her to the tenth circle of exile?

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: Of course. That's what she deserves for opposing me!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Brilliant! You've really captured the fact that in overcoming Katrina, Dinahella has `become` Katrina!
nodes.text_bbcode: Brilliant! You've really captured the fact that in overcoming Katrina, Dinahella has [color=#e23b3b][i]become[/i][/color] Katrina!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yes, exactly, I...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wait, what?!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Your character has come full-circle... From victim, to hero, to villain!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: But... I didn't want to be the villain...
Oh no! You've turned Dinah into the villain of this story!
That's not good at all! She was such a nice girl!
Do you really want to leave her like this? Why don't you try for a better ending?

args.text: Try again! You can do it!

nodes.text: After a very long day of classes, it's finally time for the lit club meeting.
Dinah hands out copies of her story and nervously waits as everyone reads...
It's too bad you didn't quite get a perfect score!
We've got a great bonus scene ready for you!
Don't you want to try one more time?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I wanted to, I just thought I should give Kat a chance to tell you first... I thought you deserved to hear it from her!
After a very long day of classes, it's finally time for the lit club meeting.
Dinah hands out copies of her story and nervously waits as everyone reads...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dinah... This is really good!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Good? This is amazing! You must have really worked hard on this!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I... I did! Do you really like it?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: We wouldn't sugarcoat our feedback for you, Dinah.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Besides, just look at this scene...

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: Dinahella, I know you care for Brendward...

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: And I... I... I don't want you to ever speak to him again!

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: But why, Katrina? Why?

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: Dinahella... Brendward and I are the only two vampires in the entire world! He's all I have.

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: But I thought you said you were Queen of the Vampires...

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: It's a largely exaggerated position...

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: So please... Let me have Brendward. Just leave us alone!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'And though Dinahella's heart was torn by Katrina's words, she understood that Katrina was only saying such things because she was afraid...'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Afraid of losing the one person in the world she thought was hers, afraid of being alone!'

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Marvelous! Simply brilliant! You've given Katrina depth. You've given her heart!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: She's a character that the reader can both pity and hate.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Yeah, that was good... But my favorite part was just before the ending!

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: Dinahella! Thank you for meeting us here.

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: Dinahella, I made a deal with the werewolves for safe haven when I came here...

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: Werewolves?! What werewolves?

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: Yes, the werewolves. But I didn't ask what the price would be.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: And now their leader, `Smud`, is demanding Brendward's heart on a platter as payment!
nodes.text_bbcode: And now their leader, [color=#3b78e2][i]Smud[/i][/color], is demanding Brendward's heart on a platter as payment!

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: Eww...

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: Will you help us fight against them?

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: I'll do whatever I can!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Just then, the vicious werewolves came crashing into the clearing!'

nodes.speaker: Smud
nodes.text: Foolish girl... Don't you realize where you are? This is our forest!

nodes.speaker: Smud
nodes.text: You really think the three of you can defeat my werewolf pack?!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'What followed was nothing short of the purest struggle between good and evil. Though they were outnumbered, Dinahella and the vampires struggled bitterly...'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Katrina and Dinahella fought alongside each other, their only thought the safety of Brendward.'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'And just when hope seemed furthest, just when all seemed lost... The battle turned, and they emerged victorious!'

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: I can't believe the three of us defeated the werewolf pack!

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: That sure was one crazy battle.

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: Who knew that good could triumph over evil? How unpredictable.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: What a crazy twist! I loved it!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, the plot was good. But more importantly, you really mastered the characters...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You gave Katrina depth as a villain, which is no small task!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: In just a couple of days, you've been able to improve remarkably! You've really shown that you can take criticism and internalize it.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: That's... Good... Right?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Of course! Dinah, I think your story is good enough to publish in the lit club's monthly magazine.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Really?! I don't know what to say!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I usually believe that a good writer should never be speechless, but in your case, I'll accept it.
After that cheerful lit club meeting, Dinah is about to head home when she sees Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Brendan? What are you doing here? School's been out for almost an hour...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I needed someone to talk to, Dinah, and I didn't know who else to turn to... So I was waiting here to talk to you.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Are you okay? What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's... It's Kat!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: She told me she kissed another guy! She cheated on me!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Brendan, I'm so sorry.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: She... She lied to me! She betrayed me!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Maybe the two of you just weren't meant to be together.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I guess you're right...
Dinah steps forward and gives Brendan a hug.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: The only good thing about this is that now you and I... Er... Can still be journalism partners...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh... Right! Journalism!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Because now we don't have to worry about Kat getting upset...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Right...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's a good thing I found out now what an evil, conniving, manipulative cheater Kat was!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well... Don't be too hard on her... You know, she gave up a lot to be with you.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What? Are you actually defending that two-faced liar?! Dinah, whose side are you on here?!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I just mean... She's going through a rough time right now.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What are you talking about?!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: And besides, Spud is her ex-boyfriend... It's not like she hooked up with some random guy.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wait... Wait a second...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I never said it was Spud.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I never said she kissed Spud! How did you know that?!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: This is going to sound bad, but I knew that Kat cheated on you.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What?! Then why didn't you tell me?!
Dinah stays up working until the early hours of the morning...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I'm exhausted... But this was worth it! I'm finally done.
An hour later, Dinah arrives at school.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yawn!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I probably shouldn't have stayed up all night working on that story... I've still got to make it through all of my classes before the lit club meeting.
Just then, Dinah sees Brendan walking towards her.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey, Dinah! What've you got there? Is that the article we were working on for journalism class?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh, no! Um... It's just a short story I've been working on.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: A short story? That's cool. Can I take a look at it?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: What?! No!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh... Okay...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Sorry, Brendan, I just mean that this story is sort of personal.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I understand. Anyway, that's not what I wanted to talk to you about.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Is something wrong?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's Kat... She's been acting really paranoid lately...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I mean, she always makes me call her to check in, but now she keeps asking me if I'm cheating on her!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And I'm starting to feel really guilty for lying to her about meeting with you to work on our articles.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I know there's nothing going on between us... And I know Ms. Prez loves our articles... But I don't want to make Kat worry.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: So maybe we should just find different partners for journalism class.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wait! But... Maybe that's not the reason why Kat is so paranoid.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What do you mean?

options.label: Maybe she's not right for you?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: If you really cared about me, you wouldn't have let me walk around like a fool thinking Kat still cared about me!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I think you at least owe me that much!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Keeping this from me... That makes you just as bad as Kat!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Brendan, don't say that!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's how I feel, Dinah!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I trusted you! Just like I trusted Kat! And you've already betrayed that trust! I guess I'm just a fool...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And all girls are just liars!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Brendan...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I just... I just need to be alone right now.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Brendan...
Well, with your help, Dinah was able to tell her story!
Brendan's not too happy with her... But some things are unavoidable.
Maybe they'll be able to patch things up...
But you'll just have to wait to find out!

args.text: Thanks for playing! See you in another episode!

nodes.text: Later that day, Dinah corners Kat in the hallway...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: There weren't very many descriptions, so the world didn't feel real at all.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Aside from that, there's the obvious cliche of a goth girl writing about vampires, which is just trite. I mean, can you play to your stereotypes any more?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Sorry, that's kind of meta. Anyway, back to the story...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: By far, the worst part of all was the simplistic treatment of the characters.
After class, Dinah lingers while packing up her backpack. Glancing up, she sees Brendan walking up to Kat.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hi, Kat.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey, Dinah! I haven't seen you around lately...

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Hey! What do you think you're doing?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... Saying 'hi' to Dinah?

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: You're flirting with her! Right in front of me!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... What?

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: I bet you'd cheat on me, wouldn't you? I bet you'd just kiss her and not tell me about it, wouldn't you?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Does... Does Kat know that I like Brendan? Does she know we've been meeting to work on journalism articles?

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Ugh! Let's just get out of here!
Kat pulls Brendan away.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I guess I'll have to wait until lunch to learn anything else about Kat...
After school is over, Dinah finds Kat at the library.
As Dinah watches, Kat's cell phone rings...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: No cell phones in the library, young lady!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Oops... Sorry!
Kat runs out of the library to answer her phone.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Huh... Kat didn't sign out of her email account...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Okay... I'm only doing this so I can understand her... That makes it okay, right?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Let's see... I guess I should check her 'sent mail'.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: There's an email to Brendan... And an email to Spud. Which should I read?
After a torturous session of gym class, it's time for lunch.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I thought gym class would never end... I'd better hurry if I'm going to catch Kat.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Let's see... Should I try to find her at her locker or just go straight to the cafeteria?

nodes.prompt: Should I try to find her at her locker or just go straight to the cafeteria?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Should I try to find her at her locker or just go straight to the cafeteria?

nodes.text: That night, Dinah sits down at her computer to rewrite her story...
Okay, this is it! The pressure is really on...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: But I think I understand more about Kat, and that was the main thing. What else did Andrew say?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh, right. I needed more descriptions... So I guess I should start with that before I even get into the character of Katrina.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Dinahella Nightingale is...'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Shoot... How should I describe her?
Later that day, Dinah corners Kat in the hallway...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: And Brendward was such a cool guy! It was just fun to read!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I'm afraid I'll have to disagree with Ashley.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I'll start. I really liked it!
And spots her grade!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: What?! She failed the English test! Wow... I didn't think Kat had any problems... I guess I was wrong.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Even I got a 'B' on that one...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: And Kat's usually a total brain... I wonder what's got her distracted.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Maybe she's going through a tough time.
And almost falls over!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Hey, what was that? Dinah?! Are you trying to look at my test?!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I... Uh... Dropped something...

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Get away from me, you freak!

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Faulkner
nodes.text: Settle down, Kat! Pay attention, girls!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yikes! I can't believe she almost caught me. I'd better not try that again!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: The romance between Dinahella and Brendward was so cute! I loved that they made each other laugh!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: The kiss was so romantic...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I thought it would be totally interesting to see how Brendward's going to get out of being King of the Vampires.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Basing the romance between Dinahella and Brendward on simple physical attraction just isn't enough!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: It makes both of the characters seem unforgivably shallow!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Katrina's character seemed to only exist to make Dinahella and Brendward unhappy... That's totally unrealistic!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And the fight between 'good' and 'evil' felt arbitrary and hollow.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Your protagonist, if we can even call her that, seems to care more about fighting her rival than loving her man. This 'Brendward' is just an afterthought to the story!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: But... I did try to tell you!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You mean earlier today?! I thought you were joking! And you sure didn't bother to correct me.
But wait! You got a perfect score!
Just for that, we'll let you get a sneak peek at Dinah's next story...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Sunset II: Before There's Darkness... There's a Sunset!'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Dinahella and Brendward thought they'd get a chance at a happily-ever-after ending...'

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: Brendward! Now we can finally be together!

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: But Dinahella, `I` am a vampire... And `you` are a human...
nodes.text_bbcode: But Dinahella, [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] am a vampire... And [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] are a human...

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: But... Um... We've known that all along...

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: It's impossible! How could our love ever be?

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: Can't you just turn me into a vampire?

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: Dinahella! Don't tempt me like that! I can't make you a vampire! I would never take away your humanity!

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: But... That's what I dream of!

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: You dream of being a horrible, undead vampire?!

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: I dream of being immortal and beautiful forever!

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: We aren't meant to be together!

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: But... But... I love you!

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: But I love you `more!`

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: That's why I'm leaving!

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: Good bye, Dinahella.

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: Brendward! What shall I ever do without you?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'But as luck and fortune would have it, after a few months of wayward wandering, Brendward saw what a fool he'd been and returned to his true love!'

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: Dinahella! What a fool I've been! Nothing should keep us apart!

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: Brendward! But... But what about everything you said? I'm a human! You're a vampire! It's impossible! Our love is dangerous! Deadly!

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: Well, we'll figure something out. Wait, I should just turn you into a vampire! That's the perfect solution!

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: Wait... But... Earlier you said...

nodes.speaker: Brendward
nodes.text: Do you want to be beautiful and immortal, or don't you?

nodes.speaker: Dinahella
nodes.text: I do! Let's go be beautiful and immortal together forever!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'And then Dinahella...'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Um...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Er...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Huh... I don't really know what else there is to say...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Maybe I'm done with this story...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I guess I could move on to some other genre...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Maybe I should try a sci-fi story! I guess I could check out that 'Brittlestar Galacticus' show Dexter was talking about...
It looks like we just might be seeing another story from Dinah in the future!
Nice job on the perfect score! See you in another episode of 'Surviving High School'!
